d:
A short doujinshi by RAITA, from the long distant past of 2017.

I noticed it awhile ago and thought the story was cute enough, with really great art - how often do you get to see an early to mid-term bump in a pregnancy comic? So here it is in full English.

Fan translation created entirely by me, with NO machine translation, LLM, or generative AI used in any way.

Enjoy, and please support the original creator however possible.
